intro: Rites of the Earthmother marks the transition of a young tauren out of the secluded Red Cloud Mesa and into the wider plains of Mulgore. Having proven your mettle in Camp Narache, Chief Hawkwind sends you north to Bloodhoof Village with a carved totem to continue the ancient trials under Baine Bloodhoof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, friend.
Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.
Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.
Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings you to my village, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
